runtime.gpu_policy: Use an unoccupied GPU reserved through the shared project GPU lock and occupancy checks.

data.split_origin: Project-generated grouped five-fold splits; all repeated measurements of one cell-drug pair share an assignment.

knowledge.comparison: Released pruned GO versus the same pruned GO with a frozen additive overlay.
knowledge.new_membership_novelty: Compare against existing descendant-propagated membership before adding a direct input.
knowledge.new_go_term_placement: Compress authoritative GO biological-process is_a ancestry to retained and selected terms.
knowledge.external_module_placement: Require an explicit parent map and preserve its model-aggregation semantics separately from GO is_a.

released_training_settings.loss: MSE(final) + 0.2 * sum(MSE(each GO and drug auxiliary head))

evaluation.checkpoint_policy: Select using validation data and evaluate the selected checkpoint on the held-out test fold.

initialization_scope: Official source and data, grouped split files, pruned GO task inputs, additive ontology adapter, and CPU runtime verification.
